title: agent-atlas Orchestrator manifest
description: The single control plane: a deterministic graph of tasks. Each task invokes one component (agent or tool); transitions between tasks express order and conditional branching. There is exactly one orchestrator per model.

state_store.description: id of a System (kind=state-store) where run/step state is externalized.

steps.description: The tasks, in declaration order. Each invokes one component; transitions express the DAG.

invokes.description: id of the agent or tool this task runs.

transitions.description: Outgoing edges. An unconditioned transition is 'then'; a 'when' makes it conditional.

when.description: condition for this branch; omit for an unconditional 'then'.
